source: BIP-39 test mnemonic of vectors/identity-derivation.json; each party role is a distinct pair context from the listed relationship nonce — no key is reused across roles

roles.note: ack/voucher keys are the CHANNEL tuples (8.1): M_R/R_M = mediator-requester channel, M_T/T_M = mediator-target channel
roles.A_B: established relationship (star, grade, mapping, prior tuple of continuity)
roles.R_T: requester's fresh context toward the target
roles.T_I: target's fresh context toward the requester

self.label: group/uEiDYLnFbXqm2cwuJWuk9yNzRmlzWDpCTH6yA_4aP_1z_RA
self.note: the community anchor at generation 1: the group-context derivation over the personal community’s genesis digest (Identity 0.52 §2, §5.4; the S-DID cut of 0.13); the vector key name „self“ mirrors the frozen wire field spelling

payloads.note: payload-level POSITIVES with real Encounter 0.24 cards (eddsa-jcs-2022) — the former card-vector debt is discharged; cardDigest preimage = the complete card document including its proof (2.1)

negative.name: mapping-foreign-self
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 steps 1-8 in order; steps 1-4a PASS (MACs are over the mutated body), step 5 FAILS

negative.name: mapping-lineage-not-ending-at-self
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 steps 1-4 PASS, step 4a FAILS: the lineage element verifies under both signatures, but its next is generation 2 while self is generation 1 (MACs are over the mutated body)
negative.expect: reject: the last next of lineage != self

negative.name: mapping-lineage-65
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 step 1 FAILS: the lineage carries 65 elements, the schema admits at most 64; every element verifies and the chain ends at self (generation 66)

negative.name: probe-shape-255
negative.expect: reject: blinded MUST have exactly 256 entries (6a.2)

negative.name: reply-wrong-request-digest
negative.fixture: requester holds the positive introductionRequest of this file for the same act
negative.checkOrder: schema PASS, signature PASS (freshly signed over the mutated body), then requestDigest comparison FAILS
negative.expect: reject: requestDigest does not match held request (8.2)

negative.name: star-salt-replay
negative.fixture: recipient state: highest completed salt for tuple (A,B) = 1 (after accepting this file's star)

2.label: group/uEiDYLnFbXqm2cwuJWuk9yNzRmlzWDpCTH6yA_4aP_1z_RA/2
2.note: generation 2 of the same community anchor: group/<digest>/2 (Identity 0.52 §5.4)

rotation.note: anchorMappingRotated: the sender A rotated its community anchor from generation 1 to 2 (anchorRotation) and re-issued the mapping on tuple (A,B) under a higher revision with lineage [anchorRotation]; B, holding anchorMapping (self = generation 1), classifies it as a ROTATION (6.3 condition 8): the previously held self is the prev of a lineage element

lineageBound.note: anchorMappingLineage64: A at generation 66 of <D> (group/<D>/66) carries the 64 most recent rotations, 2→3 … 65→66, in chain order (6.1, 6.3 condition 4a); it verifies. A contact holding generation 2 finds it in the carried segment — a ROTATION; one holding generation 1 missed more than 64 rotations — a NEW COMMUNITY (6.3 condition 8, 6.5). The 65-element mapping is the negative mapping-lineage-65
